source: https://coassemble.com/ (inline <svg class="brand-logo"> in the page header, copied byte-for-byte)
edits: kept the mark (elements 10-11: the open ring and its square), removed the 'coassemble' wordmark (elements 0-9)
the header paints it with fill=currentColor; set it to #0F171F, the colour of Coassemble's own favicon/app icon (icon.png) and the site's --text colour
cropped the viewBox to the mark
#0F171F -> #FFFFFF on the whole mark (it touches the tile and vanishes on dark)
notes: Saved the header SVG with a byte-for-byte slice (work/agents/b07/tools/slice_svg.py) because extract_svg.py lowercases viewBox to 'viewbox', which breaks crop. The header itself is currentColor (#0B1020 via --ink in the landing CSS); I used the favicon's #0F171F.
